title: Thursday at the hawker center
body: Hi, today is a Thursday and I just went down to my local hawker center to eat. Also some of you might have noticed that the "daily recordings" isn't really "daily", so I might change the name.
zhBody: 大家好，今天是周四，我刚去家附近的熟食中心吃饭。可能有人注意到“每日记录”其实做不到每日更新，我可能会改个名字。
